description:
Summarize a native trace saved by native-profiler-stop or restored with profiler-load. Returns a Markdown report with severity and suggested next steps.
Instruments reports CPU hotspots, UI hangs, and memory leaks on iOS. Android reports also include jank reasons, main-thread state, garbage collection, and memory growth as a weak leak signal.
Use profiler-stack-query for details behind a finding.

device_id.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID or Android serial).

name: native-profiler-analyze
